info.title: shotdetect
info.description: shotdetect: shot/cut detection from the command line, with the same results as PySceneDetect's scenedetect (list-scenes, stats, save-images, split-video). Needs ffmpeg.

options.name: --detector
options.description: adaptive, content, threshold, hist or hash (default: adaptive)

options.name: --threshold
options.description:
content: content_val threshold (default 27)
adaptive: adaptive ratio threshold (default 3)
threshold: mean pixel level of a fade (default 12)
hist: drop in histogram correlation (default 0.05)
hash: fraction of hash bits that differ (default 0.395)

options.name: --min-scene-len
options.description: Minimum shot length, frames or seconds e.g. 0.6s (default 0.6s)

options.name: --min-content-val
options.description: adaptive: minimum content_val for a cut (default 15)

options.name: --frame-window
options.description: adaptive: frames on each side to average (default 2)

options.name: --weights
options.description:
content/adaptive: weights of hue, saturation, luma and edge
differences in content_val (default 1 1 1 0)

options.name: --kernel-size
options.description:
content/adaptive: odd size >= 3 to widen edges by
(default: from the resolution)

options.name: --luma-only
options.description: Only use the V (brightness) channel (overrides --weights)

options.name: --bins
options.description: hist: number of luma histogram bins (default 256)

options.name: --hash-size
options.description: hash: hash is n x n bits (default 16)

options.name: --hash-lowpass
options.description: hash: shrink frames to size*n pixels per side first (default 2)

options.name: --fade-bias
options.description: threshold: cut position between fade-out (-1) and fade-in (+1)

options.name: --compat
options.description: Which PySceneDetect release to reproduce (default 0.7.1)

options.name: --ffmpeg-dir
options.description: Folder containing ffmpeg and ffprobe (default: found on PATH)

options.name: --threads
options.description:
ffmpeg decoder threads (default 4; 0 = ffmpeg's choice). Each
costs ~25 MB at 1080p; more rarely helps since we decode in parallel

options.name: --ffmpeg-resize
options.description:
Downscale with ffmpeg bilinear instead of an exact port of
cv2.resize (faster, but cuts can differ from PySceneDetect)

options.name: --csv
options.description: Write shot list as CSV

options.name: --json
options.description: Write shot list as JSON

options.name: --stats
options.description: Write per-frame metrics as CSV (like scenedetect -s)

options.name: --save-images
options.description: Save JPEG thumbnails per shot (like scenedetect save-images)

options.name: --num-images
options.description: Thumbnails per shot (default 3)

options.name: --split-video
options.description: Cut the video into one mp4 per shot (like scenedetect split-video)
